name: Vastned
summary: Vastned Retail N.V. is a European publicly listed property company focusing on the best property in the popular shopping areas of selected European cities with a historic city centre where shopping, living, working and leisure meet. Vastned property clusters have a strong tenant mix of international and national retailers, food & beverage entrepreneurs, residential tenants, and office tenants. The property portfolio had a size of approximately 1,236 million Euro as at 30 June 2024. Vastned Retail N.V. was incorporated in 1986 in Belgium.
